columns: Learn coverage paths
Public education explains Medicare coverage paths; general marketing alone does not qualify.
Self-service personal comparison
A user can operate a plan comparison using personal needs. Partial includes advisor-mediated research or a narrower linked tool; samples alone do not qualify.
Plans before contact
Useful plan results are accessible before name, email, phone or an advisor conversation. Demographic and care inputs may still be required. Contact-free articles alone do not qualify.
Revise / revisit inputs
Personal inputs, priorities or a comparison can be revisited. Partial includes advisor-mediated revision, limited controls or known correction defects; reading an article again does not qualify.
Inspectable personal reasons

The person can inspect how their priorities and evidence produce a result. Partial includes visible premium sorting, summarized fit criteria or advisor explanations without a reproducible source-linked record.
Published incentive safeguards
A concrete declared safeguard addresses sales incentives, such as no insurer compensation, equal advisor pay or consideration of nonpaying options. This is not a verified unbiasedness rating.
Data quality verified

Accuracy, material conditions, completeness and freshness are verified for a declared geography, year and product universe. Broad database claims or a limited carrier panel alone establish neither quality nor its absence.
Ease advantage demonstrated

Matched tasks with real users establish superior completion, understanding or effort. Entry checks, testimonials and provider promises do not establish this. Unknown means no adequate evidence in this review, not no study exists anywhere.
AI in plan research
AI or ML is explicitly used in matching, plan-data research or advisor research/quality tools. This does not imply consumer-facing AI, neutrality, accurate results or an AI-native architecture.
Conversational AI guidance
The user can get conversational AI help with discovery. Partial includes a spoken form guide, advisor-facing LLM Q&A or unreliable local dialogue; a score or chat button alone does not qualify.
